camel_example: aliyun gpdb ModifyDBInstancePayType --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp000000000000000' --UsedTime 1 --Period Month --PayType Postpaid
description_en: Switches between billing methods for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 包年包月/按量付费转换改造
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-pay-type --db-instance-id gp-bp000000000000000 --pay-type Postpaid --period Month --used-time 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstancePayType

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

*   Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
*   Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型，取值如下：

- Postpaid：按量付费。

- Prepaid：包年包月
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

*   Month
*   Year

This parameter must be specified only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。取值如下：

- Month：月

-  Year：年

只有包年包月需要指定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

*   Valid values when Period is set to Month: 1 to 9.
*   Valid values when Period is set to Year: 1 to 3.

This parameter must be specified only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。取值如下：

- 当 Period 为 Month 时，取值为 1~9。

-  当 Period 为 Year 时，取值为 1~3。

只有包年包月需要指定
parameters.name: used_time
